title: The Dimension of Neither Perception Nor Non-Perception
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 28.8 Linked Discourses 28.8
  • 1. Sāriputtavagga 1. With Sāriputta

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasutta The Dimension of Neither Perception Nor Non-Perception

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto …pe… Venerable Ānanda saw Venerable Sāriputta …

“idhāhaṁ, āvuso, ākiñcaññāyatanaṁ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṁ upasampajja viharāmi …pe… “Reverend, going totally beyond the dimension of nothingness, I entered and remained in the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception. …” … vuṭṭhitoti vā”ti.

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
